offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP / Reader API (https://s.jina.ai)
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage. Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, Free; Prototype Development: 1 Billion tokens for $50 (0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: 11 Billion tokens for $500 (0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 计费；搜索请求每次固定消耗至少 10,000 tokens
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens!
offerings.output_type: 包含前五条搜索结果及其 URL 和内容的、适合 LLM 的文本结果
offerings.note: 通过 s.jina.ai/?q= 查询；搜索 API 平均延迟 2.5 秒；无 API key 和免费 API key 均为 100 RPM，付费 API key 为 1000 RPM。
